## Introduction

The Indian Ocean Tuna Commission (IOTC) has adopted a comprehensive framework of [Conservation and Management Measures](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/guidelines/#cmm) governing the collection, recording, reporting, observation and management of fisheries data by Contracting Parties and Cooperating Non-Contracting Parties (CPCs). These measures define the information that must be collected and reported to the IOTC Secretariat and establish common standards for fisheries data across the Indian Ocean.

This page provides an overview of the principal data-related CMMs and their reporting requirements. Together, these measures underpin the IOTC fisheries information system and support fisheries monitoring, stock assessments, scientific advice and evidence-based fisheries management.
